blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Mark Calado haunted his alma mater as Savouge swept Far Eastern University-DN Steel, 25-23, 25-18, 25-19, in the Spikers’ Turf Invitational Conference on Wednesday at FilOil EcoOil Centre. The former Tamaraw unloaded 17 points — all from attacks — and made 15 excellent receptions to send the Spin Doctors to their second consecutive win, while FEU suffered its second straight loss. Both teams are tied at 2-2 with Alpha Insurance.
